evidence.description: Eight heatmap rows labelled Marker A–H and nine columns R01–R09; an aligned condition strip above and aligned horizontal single-value bars at right.
Contiguous borderless rectangular cells; blue negative through near-white zero to red positive. Horizontal scale shows −2, 0, 2 and Standardized score.
Strip consists of blue, ochre and teal blocks, each spanning three columns; top guide pairs these colors with Control, Treatment A and Treatment B.
Gray horizontal bars start at zero and share heatmap row centers; a pale vertical zero line and −1, 0, 1 ticks appear. Axis label Mean score.
Gray cells differ from the near-white scale midpoint; lower-right gray key reads Unmeasured. Exact gray-cell count is not relied upon.
White canvas; flat heatmap cells and strip; labels outside heatmap. Gray reference line behind summary bars; summary baseline/ticks below. Guides occupy free top and bottom areas.
